summary: Second full sweep after SPA refactor + voice integrations. Backend pytest suite expanded to 22 tests covering new endpoints (/api/route, /api/transcribe, /api/speak per-chamber voice) and all pass including real Claude deliberations and OpenAI Whisper/TTS calls. Frontend Playwright verified the new compact landing layout: 1-2-3 how-it-works strip sits ABOVE the question-input, textarea is narrow (576px, max-w-xl) and short (112px, min-h=96/max-h=160), standalone 'Review our Experts →' link sits directly below the input with correct text and data-testid, and 'Why a cortex?' / 'The archive' footer links sit below. Full convene flow works: routing → deliberating → verdict, VerdictAudio mounted and POST /api/speak invoked on play. /receipts page renders real-figure personas (Lincoln, Churchill, Aurelius, Burke, Buffett, Munger). MicButton rendered next to Convene. Fixed two stale backend assertions from iteration_1 (old generic persona ids / 3-member senate shape) to match the new real-figure persona architecture.
critical_code_review_comments: cortex_voice.transcribe_audio: the silent-WAV fallback I tested worked (200 with empty text), but the endpoint returns 200 even when Whisper yields no text. Consider returning 422 for completely empty audio so the frontend can surface a clearer 'nothing heard' message instead of a silent success.

server.py /api/speak: no length-based cost guard beyond MAX_TTS_CHARS=4000 truncation; a malicious client could hammer the endpoint with large payloads. Consider per-archive_id (or IP) rate limiting and max-char hard rejection (422) instead of silent truncation.

VerdictAudio.jsx fetches one /api/speak request per deliberation segment plus one for the verdict — a 4-witness committee fires 5 OpenAI TTS calls in sequence. Cached in memory only, so re-mount re-pays the cost. Consider server-side caching keyed on (verdict_id, segment_idx).

MicButton.jsx uses navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with no HTTPS guard message — on non-secure contexts it'll just fail silently with NotAllowedError. Preview env is HTTPS so not an issue, but add a clearer fallback for localhost dev.
Landing.jsx ContextWindow: the minHeight/maxHeight are hard-coded inline (96/160). Fine, but if you later theme the editor, extract into Tailwind classes so it's themeable.
Backend: no dedicated test for /api/verdicts persistence of voice-related fields; /api/speak is stateless (no DB write) which is correct, but that's worth documenting in the endpoint docstring.
